component.name: Time Portal
component.summary: Back up and restore your machine with real, browsable btrfs snapshots

description.p: Time Portal is Time Machine for Arch and Omarchy: every backup is a real, browsable btrfs snapshot on an encrypted drive that looks exactly like your machine at that moment, not an opaque archive.

It snapshots the system and home subvolumes, sends only the delta to a LUKS-encrypted btrfs drive, and keeps versions on Time Machine's schedule (hourly, then daily, monthly and yearly). Ownership, permissions, ACLs, xattrs, symlinks and device nodes are all preserved, so restoring a single file is a copy and restoring the machine is a subvolume swap.
